question: What should the disciple offer to the guru after completing the worship?
premises: The worship extends fully, up to the directions.
The disciple should honor the guru with gifts.
The offering may include everything, even oneself.
inference: After full worship, the disciple should make a total, devout offering to the guru.
plain_english: After worshiping him fully, even to the directions, the disciple should honor him with gifts, offering all he has and, with devout awareness, even himself.
